title: Issue map: open it with Alt+M, and list every open project (each repository of a multi-repo project too), kept up to date
summary: Alt+M now opens the issue map in project and eagle view, and the map's Project picker lists every open tab and each repository of a multi-repo project, refreshing while the map is open.

deferred.what: The issue-map test 'F5 and Ctrl+R rebuild the map from GitHub' waits only about 1 second, so it times out under full-suite load on a busy machine and makes a good branch look red locally.
deferred.why: Outside this issue, and widening a timeout is not allowed; the test needs a wait that does not depend on machine speed.
